title: c31 joins: self-made boundary layer for the wave-pinning crawler (C:motile-repair B, then C:contained-swimmers)
summary: Focus crawler-phase-field. Plan: give c22's Camley wave-pinning crawler a surfactant-like layer species produced inside the body and adsorbed at the interface (diffuse-interface Langmuir adsorption, positive control first), measure it by signed distance to the contour, ablate the source, and test repair and motion with the layer.
